implemented_requirements.requirement: Randomly generated vertical gaps in pipes
implemented_requirements.evidence: Pipe.__init__ computes a random gap_center within allowed bounds and uses settings.get_gap_size(score) to set gap size.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Difficulty adjustment via gap size and pipe speed
implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.py defines get_gap_size(score) and get_pipe_speed(score); Pipe uses get_gap_size(score).
bird.py defines Bird.flap() setting velocity to FLAP_VELOCITY and Bird.update() applying gravity, ceiling limit, and rotation.
Background.collide_ground(bird_rect) returns True when bird touches ground.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Rendering of background, clouds, ground, pipes, and bird
implemented_requirements.evidence: background.py, pipe.py, bird.py, utils.py contain draw methods for all visual elements.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Key press handling to trigger flap
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code in the provided files shows event handling or mapping a key press to Bird.flap().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Score increment on successful pipe pass
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code tracks score or marks a pipe as passed for scoring.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game over on collision with pipe or ground
implemented_requirements.evidence: Collision helpers exist but there is no game loop or state logic that ends the game on collision.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Main game loop and Game class
implemented_requirements.evidence: Only a fragment of Game.draw() is present; the Game class, run loop, and input handling are missing.

critical_issues: Missing Game class implementation and main loop; the program cannot run.
No input handling to map a key press to Bird.flap().
Score tracking and pipe‑pass detection are absent.
No overall collision detection or game‑over state management.
Difficulty adjustments (pipe speed, spacing) are defined but never applied in a running loop.
judge.summary: The repository contains well‑implemented rendering, bird physics, and pipe generation utilities, but the core game engine—including the Game class, event handling, scoring, collision response, and difficulty application—is missing. Consequently the project does not meet the required functional completeness and is unlikely to execute as a playable Flappy Bird clone.
